doc.toml:
reflex = 1

description = "Turn the lights in one room on, off, or dim them."
confirm = "Set the lights {state}?"
run = "lights.mts"

[args.state]
ask = "What should the lights do?"
options.on = "Switch on."
options.off = "Switch off."
options.dim = "Lower the brightness without switching off."

[examples]
"kill the lights" = { state = "off" }

[tests]
"Kill the lights!" = { state = "off" }
